logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

scenes.heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.

events.label: POLICE CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern)
events.content: "Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.

events.label: LORD STERLING (Snarls, Outraged)
events.content: "You have no authority!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

events.label: POLICE CONSTABLE (Cold, Definite)
events.content: "I have more than enough."

scenes.heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Shouting)
events.content: "Get your hands off me! Catherine!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Screaming)
events.content: "Do something!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

events.label: CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful)
events.content: "Alexander... I thought you had died."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

events.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping)
events.content: "Do you know what this did to me?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

events.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading)
events.content: "I mourned you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

events.label: CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling)
events.content: "I waited for you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

events.label: CATHERINE (Heartbroken)
events.content: "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

events.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing)
events.content: "I never stopped loving you."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

events.label: CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt)
events.content: "You don't remember?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

events.label: CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding)
events.content: "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable)
events.content: "You were never my Duchess."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

events.label: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading)
events.content: "But I loved you!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting)
events.content: "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

events.label: CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained)
events.content: "No!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

events.label: CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying)
events.content: "I loved you before all this!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting)
events.content: "Did you?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

events.label: CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous)
events.content: "Her?!"
